errors.text_span: „Оборот“, показва, че „Други услуги“ има най-голям дял с 31% (9,9 трлн.), последван от „Индустрия“ с 33% (10,6 трлн.), „Търговия“ с 31% (9,8 трлн.) и „Строителство“ с 6% (1,9 трлн.)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states industry as 33% and construction as 6% when the figure shows industry as 31% and construction as 6%.
The description does not clearly state the overall purpose of the chart, which is to display the relationships between sectors regarding enterprises, employment, and turnover.
